description: Design, evaluate, and readiness-check analytics agents (agentic AI for business intelligence) using the architectures, evaluation, and deployment framework from 'Agentic AI Meets BI' (under review, IEEE IT Professional). Three skills: a design advisor built on a four-pattern architecture taxonomy, an evaluation planner that goes beyond correctness to grounding and insightfulness, and a deployment readiness review across cost, reliability, security, privacy, oversight, and the KPI trust contract.
name: agentic-bi-pilot
